question:
Which of the following statements about the 56th National Kho Kho Championship 2023–24 are correct?

1. Maharashtra emerged as the overall champion by winning both men’s and women’s titles.

2. The final matches were conducted at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium and Karnail Singh Stadium in Delhi.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** Maharashtra emerged as the overall champion by winning both men’s and women’s titles in the **56th National Kho Kho Championship 2023–24**. This information is accurate as Maharashtra showcased its dominance in the tournament by claiming victories in both categories.* Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• **Statement 2:** The final matches of the championship were conducted at the **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium** and **Karnail Singh Stadium** in Delhi. These venues hosted the event, highlighting the importance of Delhi as a sporting hub.* Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• The **56th National Kho Kho Championship 2023–24** is a prestigious event that brings together athletes from across India to compete in one of the country’s traditional sports.
 
• The event witnessed outstanding performances from participating teams, with Maharashtra emerging as a key performer.
 
• **Therefore, both statements 1 and 2 are correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Kho Kho:**

 
 
• **Kho Kho** is a traditional Indian sport that involves speed, strategy, and teamwork.
 
• The sport is played by two teams of 12 players each, with nine players taking the field at a time.
 
• The objective of the game is for the chasing team to tag out as many players of the opposing team as possible within a set time limit.
 
• It originated in **Maharashtra** and has a rich history as a grassroots-level sport in India.
 
• Kho Kho is governed by the **Kho Kho Federation of India (KKFI)**, which organizes national and international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium:**
 
 
• Located in **Delhi**, it is one of India’s largest indoor stadiums.
 
• The stadium is a hub for various national and international sporting events, including badminton, wrestling, and indoor games.
 
• Its state-of-the-art facilities make it a preferred venue for hosting large-scale tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Karnail Singh Stadium:**
 
 
• Situated in **Delhi**, this stadium is primarily known for hosting cricket matches and other sports events.
 
• It is managed by the **Indian Railways** and has a significant role in promoting sports in the region.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra’s Performance in Sports:**
 
 
• Maharashtra has a strong tradition of excelling in sports, particularly in disciplines like **Kabaddi**, **Kho Kho**, and **athletics**.
 
• The state invests heavily in sports infrastructure and athlete training programs, contributing to its success in national championships.
 
 
 
• **National Championships:**
 
 
• These events aim to foster talent at the grassroots level and provide a platform for athletes to compete at higher levels.
 
• The **National Kho Kho Championship** is one of the many initiatives to preserve and promote indigenous sports in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Traditional Sports in India:**

 
 
• India is home to several traditional sports like **Kabaddi**, **Kho Kho**, **Mallakhamb**, and **Gilli Danda**.
 
• These sports form an integral part of India’s cultural heritage and are played across rural and urban areas.
 
• The government and private organizations are working to revive these sports through initiatives like the **Khelo India Program**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Championships:**
 
 
• They serve as a platform for athletes to showcase their talent and gain recognition.
 
• Winning at such events boosts the morale of players and helps them secure opportunities to represent India at international levels.
 
• These championships also play a crucial role in promoting sportsmanship and team spirit among participants.
 
 
 
• **Kho Kho in International Sports:**
 
 
• Efforts are being made to include Kho Kho in international multi-sport events like the **Asian Games**.
 
• The sport has gained popularity in countries like **Bangladesh**, **Nepal**, and **Sri Lanka**, thanks to initiatives by the **Kho Kho Federation of India**.
